finalists.label: Pancreatic Cancer
finalists.why: It has the most decisive findings including elevated tumor markers and multiple hypermetabolic lymph nodes.

finalists.label: Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm
finalists.why: It explains the diffusely enlarged pancreas and intrahepatic bile-duct dilation without any findings against it.
